arml-local-2014-relay-1-1.prompt: Compute the value of $k$ such that May $k$th and June $(4k)$th fall on the same day of the week. (Note: May has $31$ days and June has $30$ days.)

arml-local-2014-relay-1-2.prompt: Let $T=6$. A set of $k$ numbers has the sum $S$. Each number in the set is decreased by $T$, then multiplied by $T$, then increased by $T$. The sum of the new set of numbers is $mS+nk$. Compute $m+n$.

arml-local-2014-relay-2-1.prompt: Compute the sum of the solutions (in radians) of $2(\cos x-\sin x)(\sin x+\cos x)+1=0$ for $0\le x\le2\pi$.

arml-local-2014-relay-2-2.prompt: Let $T=4\pi$. Two concentric circles have radii that differ by $\frac12$ and the region inside the outer circle but outside the inner circle has area $T$. Compute the radius of the inner circle.

arml-local-2014-relay-2-3.prompt: Let $T=\frac{15}4$. $RYAN$ is a rectangle with $\dfrac{RY}{YA}=4T$. If the perimeter of $RYAN$ is also $4T$, compute the area of $RYAN$.

arml-local-2014-relay-3-1.prompt: In the multiplication problem $\underline{A}\times\underline{B}\,\underline{C}=\underline{B}\,\underline{B}\,\underline{B}$, each letter represents a different digit. Compute the value of $A+B+C$.

arml-local-2014-relay-3-2.prompt: Let $T=19$. The sequence of numbers $a_1,a_2,\dots,a_k$ is defined by $a_i=2\times a_{i-1}+b$. If $a_2=5$ and $a_5=T$, compute $b$.

arml-local-2014-relay-3-3.prompt: Let $T=-3$. The graphs of $y=2x^2+Tx+1$ and $y=19-x^2$ intersect at two points. Compute the slope of the line through these two points.

arml-local-2014-relay-3-4.prompt: Let $T=-1$. The numbers $1+T$, $1+T^2$, $1+T^3$, $1+T^4$, $1+T^5$, and $1+T^6$ are on the faces of a fair six sided die. Compute the expected value of one roll of this die.

arml-local-2014-relay-3-5.prompt: Let $T=1$. A fair six sided die is rolled, getting a number $x$. Then $x$ fair six sided dice are rolled. Compute the expected sum of the $x$ die rolls, given that $x>T$.

arml-local-2014-relay-3-6.prompt: Let $T=14$, and let $S=2\lceil T/2\rceil$. Compute the smallest positive integer $x$ that satisfies the following $\frac S2-1$ conditions: $x$ has a remainder of $2$ when divided by $4$, $x$ has a remainder of $4$ when divided by $6$, $\dots$, $x$ has a remainder of $S-2$ when divided by $S$.
